_comment: Copy to operator-live-proofs.json (same folder). Set status to pass only after real dated evidence. Gate reads this file; never invent PASS.
head_note: Before certifying, npm run gate:operator so operator-gate-evidence.json.head equals the published git SHA (not an old head like 3558524).

rls_remote_probe.detail: Optional override if probe cannot run in CI — prefer: node scripts/validate-rls-remote.mjs with SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

rag_remote_probe.detail: Optional override after npm run rag:seed against production

e2e_authenticated.detail: Optional override after: E2E_ACCESS_EMAIL=… E2E_ACCESS_PASSWORD=… npx playwright test e2e/authenticated.spec.ts

account_deletion_live.detail: Required: controlled test user wipe — paste BEFORE row counts and AFTER zero/absent rows (service_role)

backup_restore_drill.detail: Required: follow docs/backup-dr.md — staging restore + smoke checklist, dated

shopify_cron_staging.detail: Required: Shopify webhook HMAC accepted + /api/cron/daily-pushes with secret on staging

leaked_password_protection.detail: Required: Supabase Auth → leaked password protection enabled
